title: Articulatory features of plosive consonants for early detection of Parkinson's disease
citation: Extracted voice onset time feature deposit, Zenodo 10406860.

population.description: 27 individuals diagnosed with Parkinson's disease and 27 healthy controls.
limitations: The deposit contains derived measurements only. There is no audio.

failure_reasons: Without audio there is nothing for a candidate implementation to be run against, so this cannot serve as a reference for any computational or analytical validation.
Published summary values from another protocol are not a reference range for a different task, population or capture path.

findings: Temporal and spectral features extracted from voice onset time segments of the plosives in rapid syllables, supplied as two feature files.
The features are already the output of somebody else's unvalidated extraction choices, so they cannot check a different implementation.

reasons: Openly licensed and freely obtainable, and still not a reference source, because it holds numbers rather than speech.
